The original specification's null release input and remaining preparation notes describe its earlier preparation state, while the supplied preview provides the frozen release input. This review uses no candidate results or inferred human attestations. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated bindings; I did not independently recompute them, execute code, or verify a build.
